jobs.title: View Role
jobs.description: Technical Specialist - Anzu Advertise Solution Fraud Detection Brand Uplift Monetize Solution Mobile PC & Console Learn Blog Posts Case Studies Reports Webinars Newsletters Company About Careers News Contact LOG IN SIGN UP PROGRAMMATIC TECHNICAL OPERATIONS SPECIALIST PROGRAMMATIC TECHNICAL OPERATIONS SPECIALIST? WE WANT YOU! ISRAEL We’re proud to offer innovative products that meet the needs and wants of our customers. To help us continue expanding our offerings, we’re looking for a Programmatic Technical Operation Specialist with a strong background in Ad Tech. You will be the primary point of escalation, knowledge source, and authority on all matters related to integrations with partners and vendors. ABOUT US Anzu is the most advanced intrinsic in-game ad solution for mobile, PC, console, and web. Anzu’s in-game ads put players first and help advertisers reach audiences programmatically in a highly engaging way. A patented 3D ad tracking engine, the first to bring viewability measurement in-game, partnerships with trusted AdTech vendors, and compliant with the industry measurement standards outlined by the MRC and IAB make Anzu the preferred in-game advertising partner for brands and agencies worldwide. WHAT WILL YOU DO? Support the operation of interstitial, rewarded, and banner ads alongside CTV, audio, and other opportunities. Work with demand, supply, 3P vendors, and RND to understand and support ad server logic, RTB flows, setup, and troubleshooting. Monitor key performance metrics (fill rate, win rate, latency, revenue, IVT, and discraptancy) and assist in investigating issues. Assist with troubleshooting by reviewing logs, basic bidstream data, or running SQL queries. Support DSP/SSP and vendor integrations and help validate new features. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? 1 year of experience in AdTech or a technical SaaS environment. Basic understanding of programmatic advertising and ad tech concepts (or strong willingness to learn). Comfort working with data and metrics; basic SQL / scripting knowledge. Organized, curious, and hands-on mindset. Clear communicator and strong team player. Nice to have : In-app advertising, Prebid, server-side bidding, or bidder optimization exposure. WHY ANZU? Industry-leading global company in the in-game advertising market Exciting opportunity to dive into the popular worlds of gaming, esports, advertising Central HQ in Tel Aviv, with hybrid working and remote teams around the globe Great opportunity for professional growth across multiple areas of expertise, working with cutting-edge technology Work with AAA and indie gaming studios to make gaming a better place Equal opportunity employer with an inclusive environment for all employees And much, much more… INTERESTED?
